title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.3
subtitle: Change your cache folder and keep baking.

highlights.title: Rebake Into a New Folder
highlights.description: Your previous Cloth NeXt cache can stay in its original folder while the next Bake uses your new destination.

highlights.title: Keep Your Previous Results
highlights.description: Changing the output folder leaves older folders untouched and preserves playback rollback while a new cache is created.

fixes.text: A folder change no longer triggers the misleading previous-cache removal error, including when the old file is missing or was a cancelled preview.
Unrecognized previous mesh-cache paths now explain that ownership could not be verified.
